_comment: Copy for the welcome email sent the moment someone subscribes (src/welcome_email.py). Set enabled to false to stop sending. Keep it plain and personal: a text-forward note lands in Primary far more often than a designed marketing template.
subject: Welcome to Patriot Daily Alerts — do this one thing first
preheader: Your first briefing lands tomorrow morning.
intro: Twice a day, morning and evening, we send you the three stories that actually matter, written from a conservative perspective, with the sources named so you can check every word yourself. Two minutes to read.
ask_heading: One favor before your first issue arrives.
ask_intro: Email providers put new senders in the wrong folder by default. Ten seconds now and you won't miss anything:
ask_steps: find this email in Promotions and drag it to Primary. When it asks “Do this for future messages?” — say yes.
tap the sender name at the top, then “Add to Contacts.”
ask_outro: Do it once and you're set.
stories_heading: While you're here, today's front page
reply_line: If there's a story you think the networks are ignoring, hit reply and tell us. That's how a lot of our best coverage starts.
